implementation_warning: This contract distinguishes the v9-v13 truth at the package base, the current v15_01 read-only slice, and NEXT schema. It does not claim that a migration was applied to any database.
global_rules: Keep v9 Google IDs and semantics unchanged; Meta identity lives in isolated account-scoped tables.
Reuse the exact v10 intent-blueprint-lote-item-validation-receipt workflow; do not invent absent columns or foreign keys.
Every Meta external identity is scoped by its account or parent object.
Secrets remain in Cofre references and never appear in browser payloads, logs or receipts.
criativo_master is the canonical asset; a Meta upload is an account-scoped association.
Do not describe observation/absence tracking as temporal relationship history.

trafego_campanha.note: Google-shaped; customer_id and campaign_id cannot store Meta identity.

trafego_snapshot_conta.note: Current account snapshot, not snapshot_id history.

trafego_vinculo.note: Google campaign/project linkage; do not reuse for Meta without a provider-aware contract.

trafego_evento.note: Reusable audit pattern, but its concrete campaign identity remains v9-shaped.

trafego_lote.note: The batch itself has no idempotency key.

trafego_recibo.note: Preserve exact v10 attempt/desfecho constraints and indexes.

criativo_master.authority: Canonical immutable asset with content_hash, MIME, measured dimensions/storage, rights and lineage.

cofre_meta.constraint: No safe view or function returns localizador; a privileged broker must resolve it.

current_v15_read_only_slice.scope: Hierarchy read model and sync receipts only; no Insights, asset upload or mutation plan.

objects.name: trafego_meta_project_binding
objects.temporal_semantics: confirmed interval: confirmado_em -> desfeito_em; one open project binding per ad account

objects.name: trafego_meta_ad_creative_binding
objects.semantics: current observed association with observado_em/ausente_desde; this is not full relationship history

current_v15_read_only_slice.security: RLS forced; browser roles receive no table grant; service_role is the backend path.

next_schema.name: trafego_meta_ad_creative_binding_history
next_schema.purpose: Preserve actual association intervals when relationship history is required.
next_schema.rule: Do not retrofit the current absence row as if it were historical.

next_schema.name: trafego_meta_asset_upload
next_schema.purpose: Associate criativo_master with an upload result in one Meta ad account.
constraints: exactly one of meta_image_hash/meta_video_id for its kind

next_schema.name: trafego_meta_insight_daily
next_schema.note: NULL is not zero. Attribution and breakdown keys are canonical serializations.

next_schema.name: trafego_meta_insight_action_daily
next_schema.note: Preserves actions/action_values without collapsing types or attribution windows.

unresolved_preconditions.decision: Reverify fields, action types, windows and breakdown compatibility against the pinned Graph API version.
Implement and test server-side credential resolution/redaction.
Choose whether full ad-creative history is required; current v15 records current observation/absence only.
Set TTL/purge policy for raw errors, cursors and Insights before migration.

security.rls: Mandatory on every new table with tenant/account isolation.
security.safe_reads: Exclude credential references and unnecessary raw provider payloads.
security.raw_payloads: Only with redaction, declared purpose and retention.
